name: MonarchAiStopButton
title: AiStopButton
summary: The Stop control for a streaming assistant response: a standard Button with a square stop symbol, and a stopped state that shows "Stopped." with an optional Continue button.
whenToUse: When an assistant response streams and the person must be able to interrupt it, and you want the stopped confirmation with a way to continue.
whenNotToUse: For cancelling a task that is not an assistant response (an upload, an export), use MonarchButton with a title for that task.
api: MonarchAiStopButton.init(size: MonarchButtonSize = .sm, isStopped: Bool = false, stopLabel: String? = nil, stoppedLabel: String? = nil, continueLabel: String? = nil, showsLabel: Bool = true, onContinue: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)

options.name: size
options.description: The height and padding of the Stop and Continue buttons: sm, md or lg.

options.name: isStopped
options.description: Whether the response has stopped. Replaces Stop with the stopped text.

options.name: showsLabel
options.description: Whether the stop title is visible beside the symbol. It stays the spoken name when hidden.

options.name: onContinue
options.description: Adds a Continue button to the stopped state.

options.name: action
options.description: Runs when Stop is activated. Abort the request here.

states.name: running
states.description: A secondary button with a filled square symbol and the title "Stop".

states.name: running, symbol only
states.description: With showsLabel false only the square is shown.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The Stop button in the disabled colours, set with the standard disabled(_:) modifier.

states.name: stopped
states.description: The button is replaced by the muted text "Stopped.".

states.name: stopped with Continue
states.description: The stopped text followed by a ghost Continue button.

appearance: Stop is the secondary Monarch button: a bordered surface with the default text colour in every theme. The stopped text uses the muted text role. In the high-contrast themes the same roles resolve to stronger colours.
platformNotes: The web offers the sm and md sizes; iOS takes any MonarchButtonSize, so lg also works. The web moves keyboard focus to Continue when a focused Stop is removed; on iOS the stopped text is announced and VoiceOver focus is left to the system. Escape is not wired here either: the screen that owns the request decides. The web's buttonProps pass-through has no equivalent; use standard SwiftUI modifiers on the component.
accessibility: Stop is a standard Button named by the stop text, also when showsLabel is false. The square symbol is decorative.
When isStopped changes to true the stopped text is posted as a VoiceOver announcement.
The stopped text is a plain text element, so it can be read again by moving to it.
Stop and Continue keep a 44-point touch target at every size.
Every text scales with Dynamic Type. When the stopped text and Continue do not fit on one line they stack.
edgeCases: A long stopped text wraps, and Continue moves under it when the two do not fit side by side.
isStopped with no onContinue shows only the text; there is nothing to activate.
The component does not track the request. It shows Stop until isStopped is set.
